description: GuardDuty is not enabled in the observed AWS Region
rationale: The GuardDuty detector inventory for the Region was fully enumerated and contains no detector, so the account receives no GuardDuty threat detection there. A denied, unsupported or incomplete inventory remains UNKNOWN and never triggers this finding. A DISABLED detector is reported separately by guardduty-detector-disabled. This does not assess delegated-administrator or organization-wide coverage.
remediation: Enable GuardDuty in this Region (or through the organization's delegated administrator with auto-enable for member accounts) and confirm that the expected protection plans are active.
